title: C269: Audit C260 hinge qualification coverage
body:
## Why

The four finite hinge interfaces are integrated, but component test totals do not establish every C260 H01–H28 obligation. This audit maps actual independent evidence before further qualification work.

## Result

All 28 groups and 99 material subcases are mapped to assertions, independently constructed inputs and exact recorded outcomes. Coverage is 24 complete groups and four partial groups: H16, H20, H22 and H24 (94 complete/five partial subcases). Full C260 qualification remains unestablished. The proposed next scope is one source-valid declared/computed SiteRef control for H16; it was not executed here.

No observer, product, existing test, fixture, contract, dependency, semantic, budget or hosted-workflow behavior changed. Original execution provenance and failures remain preserved.

## Review and validation

Independent reviewer `/root/state_audit` approved audit content at `4258e001a567ff830b790a174f8bdde9d368f05a`, with no mandatory findings and 1,882 static checks. Fresh documentation and workflow checks passed on both identified candidates. All 218 audit input identities and reference bindings passed. No original behavioral suite was rerun.

## Remaining gates

Owner `c269-audit-d59e10906594` will verify the actual merge/main tree, run fresh applicable main checks, observe retained branch history and automatic branch deletion, then save the verified final ZIP/prompts and publish a separate receipt. Scope issue #268 remains open until every gate passes. Stop after this phase; no H16 implementation in this PR.

title: C266: bind source and object provenance for hinge comparison
body:
Before hinge fields can be compared, the source bundle and exported GLB must be shown to refer to the same declarations. C266 adds an isolated source/program/object provenance binding prerequisite using pinned C265, C261 and permitted C257 utilities.

It checks canonical source identity, complete object sets and both repeated mapping records against source-derived facts. It supports correctly rebound changed inputs and rejects stale, sparse or contradictory provenance. Hinge values, complete joint sets, ordered endpoints and historical admission remain unqualified.

This recovery publishes the preserved candidate results, all ten previously ignored logs, independent audits and bounded closure guidance. The published candidate passed ten groups, 222 methods, fourteen corpus bindings and 748 expected C266 outcomes. Independent review and exact-input audits approve reuse; fresh workflow/documentation checks pass.
